sloka: तावत् यावत् हि मे प्राप्तम् ब्राह्मण्यम् तपसा आर्जितम् ।अनुच्छ्वसन् अभुंजाः तिष्ठेयम् शाश्वती समाः ॥१-६४-१९॥
transliteration: tāvat yāvat hi me prāptam brāhmaṇyam tapasā ārjitam ।anucchvasan abhuṁjāḥ tiṣṭheyam śāśvatī samāḥ ॥1-64-19॥

translations.english: Until brahminhood is obtained by my austerities, I shall stay without breathing or eating for innumerable years. While performing penance, my limbs shall not undergo deterioration".
